source_map.note: photo px (x, y) -> panel mm: X = a0*x + a1*y + a2, Y' = a3*x + a4*y + a5, then on the raised panel Y = Y' + dy(X, Y') with xn = (X - xc)/xs, yn = (Y' - yc)/ys, dy = c0 + c1*yn + c2*xn + c3*xn*yn + c4*xn^2 + c5*xn^2*yn (levels the grooves)

origin: top-left (rear-left) corner of the top-view outline; x right, y towards the player
accuracy: positions within a section +-0.3 mm; absolute +-1 mm in x (the two dealer photos differ by up to 2 mm), +-0.5 mm in y; lower-left panel and keys +-1 mm

case.note: case rim and side bevels in shade

panel.note: the grey panel (late, lighter grey #777778 in the neutral Soundgas shot, olive #6A6653 on an early unit, #6E6A62 in the Commons photo)

panel_lower.note: the lower left (bender) panel and right cheek, same plastic, a touch darker

shelf.note: the rear jack shelf and the battery lid, a level below the panel

groove_dark.note: moulded grooves round the sections: a dark line with a light edge

groove_light.note: the lit edge of each groove

channel.note: the recessed channel round each slider, with a dark left/bottom edge

cap_black.note: slider and switch caps (016H057/059/060), black with a coloured line

stripe_green.note: MODULATOR RATE and SOURCE MIXER caps

stripe_orange.note: VCO, VCF, ENV and bender caps

knob_black.note: rotary knobs (016H071), black with an orange pointer

key_gap.note: gaps between keys and the key bed

jack_black.note: jack holes and the DC IN housing

fonts.logos: Roland and the dot-matrix SH-101 are logotypes, traced into the artwork pack
